jobs.title: Director Commercial Pricing and Data Governance
jobs.description:
Purpose

As the Director of Commercial Pricing and Data Governance at UNFI, you are responsible for developing and executing the company's enterprise-wide pricing strategy while leading the Data Governance function. Your role is critical in driving commercial excellence, ensuring data integrity, and enabling informed business decisions across the organization.

In the area of pricing, your scope includes building and leading a centralized pricing department that will define, govern, and continuously improve UNFI Canada’s brand and customer pricing strategy. This role will move the organization toward a more disciplined pricing model, shifting pricing ownership away from Sales over time so that Sales can remain focused on customer relationships, execution of brand strategies, and commercial growth. You will immediately assume leadership of pricing activities currently managed within SRM and RGM, while developing the structure, tools, processes, resource requirements, governance model, and transition plan required to bring Sales pricing responsibilities into the pricing organization in the medium term. You will establish clear decision-making protocols, pricing guardrails, escalation processes, analytical capabilities, and best practices to support consistent, data-driven pricing decisions that improve margin performance, strengthen customer and supplier strategies, and deliver both immediate and long-term revenue value.

In the area of Data Governance, you will lead the Retalix Pricing, Retalix Maintenance, and MCB teams. You are accountable for ensuring data quality, governance, and integrity across Supplier Services, including pricing updates, GS1 data management, new brand onboarding information, and system master data maintenance. Your leadership will ensure that core data processes are effectively managed and aligned with business and operational requirements.

By partnering closely with cross-functional teams and senior leaders, you will enable the successful execution of UNFI's strategic priorities through the effective use of data and analytics. You will foster a culture of accountability, agility, and data-driven decision-making while ensuring alignment with UNFI's vision and objectives. Ultimately, your role is to drive sustainable revenue growth, improve profitability, and maximize the value of data as a strategic asset across the organization.

Job Responsibilities

Lead Pricing Strategy (50%)

Develop the brand and customer pricing strategy for UNFI Canada
Review and optimize our current pricing tools and governance
Immediately take on SRM/RGM pricing and bring forward the recommendation (inclusive of tools and resources) to take pricing on from the sales team
Establish and enforce guardrails, policies, and pricing strategies to ensure adherence to revenue targets, margin optimization, and overall revenue growth.
Serve as a subject matter expert and provide deep understanding of customer economics, supplier dynamics, and market sensitivities to enable win-win pricing and solution proposals.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Supplier Services, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, and IT, to address executional barriers, develop innovative pricing solutions, and align strategies with organizational objectives and initiatives.
Collect and communicate IT business requirements and play key role in deployment of technical and system enhancements to ensure minimal risk to internal and external customers

Data Governance (30%)

Drive the implementation of data governance practices and ensure effective utilization of data analytics for prescriptive insights across all teams, supporting data-driven decision-making processes
Conduct continuous reviews of revenue strategies, team processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement, scalability, and efficiency gains.
Drive pricing research projects, evaluate competitive pricing strategies, and analyze market impacts to provide actionable recommendations for business growth and revenue optimization.
Lead the data team that is responsible for Retalix Maintenance, Retalix pricing, MCB and GS1 inputs
Develop plans for the department that optimize, simplify and automate daily pricing routines.
Automate and simplify our MCB processes
Lead out Debit balance meeting and process

Leadership and Coaching (20%)

Conduct continuous reviews of revenue strategies, team processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement, scalability, and efficiency gains.
Drive pricing research projects, evaluate competitive pricing strategies, and analyze market impacts to provide actionable recommendations for business growth and revenue optimization.
Lead the development of pricing tools and materials for use in different department inclusive of training
Partner with sales leadership to ensure RGM principles are applied in annual planning process
Performs other duties and projects as assigned
Leads and supports teams’ daily activities in review growth strategy execution

Education

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in finance, marketing, business, or equivalent experience.

Experience

12+ years’ experience, preferably with background in financial and analytical customer/client facing roles
Financial modeling experience
Customer-facing experience
Experience with SQL; Power BI preferred

Knowledge/Skills/ Abilities

Excellent organizational and relationship skills
Managing complexity
Strong work ethic with positive, proactive, and flexible attitude
Must be self-driven and very motivated.
Ability to work under pressure and time constraints as well as handling several tasks simultaneously required.
Manage a team; Supervise and provide guidance to all direct reports including approving staffing, budgets, and work performed. 
Strong Strategic Planning, Financial and Operations / Business Background. Not purely financial background.
Communicate effectively, strong communications skills across multiple levels of the company
Lead inclusively and collaboratively

Deliver customer value; providing solutions and insight that deliver customer-centric results

jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field. This benefit can be combined with other benefits for personalized medical services.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Development Change & Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Evinova is a health-tech business within the AstraZeneca Group, created to accelerate better health outcomes by driving digital transformation across the life sciences sector. We bring together science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and deep human insight to design digital solutions that help healthcare work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are changing how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience it, with solutions built to scale and to deliver better outcomes for patients worldwide.

We are driven by a shared purpose: to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex problems, continuously learning and evolving in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

We are seeking a Director, Clinical Development Change & Transformation Lead to drive the change management and adoption work that turns Evinova's solutions into new ways of working across clinical development. Working within the transformation strategy and roadmap set by Evinova's Clinical Development Digital Innovation & Transformation leadership, you will lead the day-to-day delivery: redesigning processes with functional owners, preparing and equipping the workforce for change, and building the working relationships with Therapeutic Areas and Clinical Operations that turn deployment into real adoption and captured benefit.

You will be a visible, trusted presence on the ground in Mississauga — understanding the stakeholder landscape, running rollout and readiness activities, keeping communication and governance cadences moving, and channelling frontline insight and new ideas back to our product teams. As our solutions mature, you will help turn what works into repeatable playbooks and deliverables that support external customers on their own change journeys.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced change practitioner who combines clinical development fluency with practical transformation delivery — organized, independent amid ambiguity, credible with senior customers, and energized by turning bold technology into real-world change.

Responsibilities

Change & Adoption Delivery: Lead the delivery of change management and adoption plans for Evinova's AI-enabled solutions across clinical development, translating the transformation strategy and roadmap into actionable workstream plans, turning points, and deliverables.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationships:
Build and maintain working relationships across Therapeutic Areas, Clinical Operations, and enabling functions (e.g., Biometrics, Regulatory, Medical Writing, Quality). Maintain the stakeholder landscape map, act as a day-to-day point of contact for adoption, and prepare and support senior-level engagement where needed.

Process Redesign:
Lead process redesign workshops with functional and process owners: document current-state workflows, co-design AI-enabled future-state ways of working, and drive the actions needed to transition, including inputs to the controlled procedure and training updates that a regulated environment requires.

Workforce Readiness & Capability Building:
Deliver role and skills impact assessments, develop and run training and upskilling programs, and help embed responsible, compliant use of AI into daily work.

Rollout Execution:
Manage rollout execution in partnership with Product, Delivery, and customer teams — wave plans, readiness assessments, training logistics, hypercare, and post-launch support — and track issues and risks through to closure.

Communications & Governance:
Develop and run communication plans and engagement cadences across functions and sites, prepare executive updates and governance materials, and facilitate working groups and change forums.

Adoption Measurement & Benefits Tracking:
Track adoption and value measures — utilization, cycle-time and effort reduction, time-to-value, and user satisfaction — build the associated reporting and dashboards, and contribute to benefits validation with Finance against the argument.

Feedback Channels & Product Input: Run structured feedback channels — user advisory groups, voice-of-customer sessions, and adoption analytics — synthesize insight into prioritized recommendations and new ideas for Product, and support pilots and user validation of improvements before scaling.

Playbooks & External Customer Support: Contribute to and maintain transformation playbooks, toolkits, and deliverables, and support Commercial and Delivery teams in deploying them with external sponsors and CROs on their change journeys.

Change Champion Network: Build and coach the change champion and practitioner network across the portfolio, and lead the matrixed or small-team resources assigned to change workstreams [confirm team scope with Talent Acquisition].

Qualifications

Required (Must-Have)

Significant experience delivering change management, transformation, or technology adoption programs within pharmaceutical R&D, biotech, or health technology.
Strong understanding of clinical development and Clinical Operations processes, roles, and pain points — from protocol design through study conduct and close-out.
Hands-on experience implementing AI or digital solutions into ways of working, including impact assessments, process redesign, and training and capability building.
Strong stakeholder management: credibility with Director- and Senior Director-level stakeholders and the ability to influence across a matrixed, global organization.
Practical process redesign and facilitation skills (e.g., Lean, design thinking, or service design methodologies), with the ability to run workshops and produce clear current-state and future-state deliverables.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to craft change narratives, training content, and executive-ready updates.
Experience running feedback mechanisms and translating user insight into actionable recommendations.
Comfort defining and tracking adoption metrics and benefits, including building reporting and dashboards.
Organized, independent delivery: able to manage multiple workstreams amid ambiguity and competing priorities and drive issues to resolution.
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus.

Additional Qualifications

Experience within a SaaS, product-led, or digital health organization.
Formal change management certification (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, ACMP CCMP).
Familiarity with GxP-regulated environments and clinical trial technologies (study design platforms, eCOA, RBQM, and monitoring solutions).
Experience supporting generative or agentic AI deployments in an enterprise setting.
Experience building and leading change champion networks or communities of practice.
Experience in customer-facing roles across sponsor, CRO, or vendor environments.

Financial Planning & Forecasting

new_jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Director, Capital Markets Finance, you will provide high quality reporting & advisory support to the Global Markets management team on financial and business performance, planning and forecasting. This includes reporting & analysis of the financial resources (e.g. revenue, expense, leverage, assets, liabilities, & FTE), planning and forecasting, performing/providing insights to Actual to Plan and DFE to GL variance analysis, and assessing the financial performance and developing financial plan for initiatives. This role will support Global Equities desks in Global Markets. It is an individual contributor role.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed

Reporting & analysis – Review daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly financial results and provide high quality, insightful and timely analysis of financial performance for Global Markets businesses. Identify opportunities for cost savings and support the effective management of Balance Sheet, Funding/Liquidity and Capital Resources (RWA, Leverage and Regulatory Capital). Ensure that reporting and analysis keep pace with the changing business and environment.
Planning and forecasting – Coordinate and support the development of the financial strategic and business plans for Global Markets. Work closely with business heads, Risk and Capital Management, to ensure reasonableness of market assumptions and impact of expected regulatory changes to ensure successful execution. Understand and review allocations to the business and be able to work closely with the counterparts in other areas of the bank to challenge allocations and ensure they are reasonable.
Business initiatives - Work closely with the business leader to provide sound financial advice on strategic and tactical initiatives and projects. Provide leadership, accountability and facilitate the implementation of business optimization/process reengineering, and strategic initiatives impacted supported businesses.
Collaboration - Establish and build healthy working relations and partnerships with the business leaders in Global Markets, as well as peers in Risk Management, Operations, Technology, Treasury and other areas of Finance.

Who You Are

You can demonstrate a minimum of 5 years experience in a Finance role, have a professional accounting designation and/or a post graduate business degree; good financial accounting knowledge and the ability to comprehend complex accounting issues and summarize them for the business; strong problem solving, analytical, judgment and change implementation capabilities.
You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
You're passionate about people. You find meaning in relationships, and surround yourself with a diverse network of partners. You build trust through respect and authenticity
You're driven by collective success. You know that collaboration can transform a good idea into a great one. You understand the power of an inclusive team that enjoys working together to bring a shared vision to life.
You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.
